2609.09815.title: UnitBoost: Managing Compound LLM Systems with a Merge Operator, Not a Model
2609.09815.paper_summary: Compound LLM systems often solve a coordination problem by adding a higher-level LLM. The resulting meta-agent reads workers' outputs, writes the final answer, allocates later calls, and decides when to stop. It is expressive, but it also concentrates three control decisions in an opaque, order-sensitive model call. We ask whether the manager needs to be generative at all. UnitBoost replaces that model with a defined meta-level operator: a task-given unit map turns worker outputs into slot-value proposals, a constrained argmax assembles the output, and the slots left unfilled or unsupported become an explicit residual for the next round. The operator is order-free, records unit provenance, and gives a simple guarantee: without coupling constraints, unit-wise maximization under the same admission score dominates selection of any complete candidate. On three held-out benchmarks, it exceeds the best single candidate chosen with gold labels by 0.060-0.195 absolute task-score points and input-matched generative managers by 0.048-0.076. Replacing only the management step improves six compound-system configurations by 0.013-0.182. Residual-directed rounds raise FanOutQA cell F1 from 0.4778 to 0.5524; matched controls show that the true residual outperforms random targets and ordinary rereading, while a label-free supply signal flags exhaustion after one unproductive round. The same analysis measures three conditions in which no such gain is available (one indivisible unit, unavailable unit identity, and an endpoint that charges for every emitted unit) and quantifies cross-unit coupling as a repair cost. The manager gives up semantic freedom and gains order invariance, unit provenance, and testable failure conditions.
2609.09815.paper_summary_zh: 複合 LLM 系統通常通過添加一個高層次的 LLM 來解決協調問題。所產生的元代理讀取工作者的輸出，撰寫最終答案，分配後續調用，並決定何時停止。它具有表達能力，但也將三個控制決策集中在一個不透明的、對順序敏感的模型調用中。我們問經理是否根本需要是生成式的。UnitBoost 用一個定義的元級運算符取代該模型：一個任務給定的單位映射將工作者輸出轉化為槽值提議，一個受限的 argmax 組合輸出，而未填充或未支持的槽則成為下一輪的明確殘餘。該運算符是無序的，記錄單位來源，並提供一個簡單的保證：在沒有耦合約束的情況下，同一入場分數下的單位最大化主導任何完整候選的選擇。在三個保留的基準測試中，它超過了用金標籤選擇的最佳單一候選者 0.060-0.195 絕對任務分數點，以及與輸入匹配的生成式經理 0.048-0.076。僅替換管理步驟使六個複合系統配置提高了 0.013-0.182。殘餘導向的輪次將 FanOutQA 單元 F1 從 0.4778 提高到 0.5524；匹配的對照顯示，真實殘餘的表現優於隨機目標和普通的重讀，而無標籤的供應信號在一輪無效後標記耗盡。同樣的分析測量了三種沒有此類增益的條件（單一不可分割單位、不可用的單位身份，以及每發出一個單位就收費的端點），並量化跨單位耦合作為修復成本。經理放棄了語義自由，獲得了順序不變性、單位來源和可測試的失敗條件。
